findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: compute_vimshottari_dasha · Private data: compute_birth_chart, convert_calendar_date, compute_panchang, find_eclipses, compute_transits · Public sink: convert_calendar_date, compute_panchang, compute_moon_phase, find_eclipses, compute_vimshottari_dasha, compute_transits, get_planetary_positions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: compute_vimshottari_dasha · Private data: compute_birth_chart, convert_calendar_date, compute_panchang, find_eclipses, compute_transits · Public sink: convert_calendar_date, compute_panchang, compute_moon_phase, find_eclipses, compute_vimshottari_dasha, compute_transits, get_planetary_positions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
